hooks.command: file="$TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH"; if echo "$file" | grep -qE '\.(tsx|jsx|ts|js|vue|svelte|html|dart)$' && ! echo "$file" | grep -qE '\.(test|spec|stories)\.' && ! echo "$file" | grep -qE '\.(json|yaml|yml|arb|po|properties)$'; then content=$(cat "$file" 2>/dev/null); matches=$(echo "$content" | grep -nE '(>\s*[A-Z][a-z]+[\s,]|"[A-Z][a-z]+(\s+[a-z]+){2,}"|'\''[A-Z][a-z]+(\s+[a-z]+){2,}'\'')' | head -5); if [ -n "$matches" ]; then echo "⚠️  Possible hardcoded strings detected in $file:"; echo "$matches" | while IFS= read -r line; do echo "   $line"; done; echo ""; echo "💡 Run /smart-i18n:scan to find all translatable strings."; fi; fi
